run_solve_tril_16x16: run the Triton kernel solve_tril_16x16_kernel to compute block inverse for 16x16 matrices
run_merge_16x16_to_32x32: run the Triton kernel merge_16x16_to_32x32_inverse_kernel to merge 16x16 blocks into 32x32 inverse
